summary: Stripe processed $1.9 trillion in payment volume in 2025, up 34%, was valued at $159 billion in a February 2026 tender offer backed by Thrive Capital, Coatue and a16z, and is estimated by PM Insights to have reached $6.8 billion in revenue. Risks include an alleged customer data exposure, large AI customers such as OpenAI and Anthropic diversifying away from sole reliance on Stripe, and revenue figures that are outside estimates. Pursue, because independent sources back strong growth and profitability and none of the risks rises to fraud, insolvency, regulatory action or a business-threatening lawsuit.

facts.text: Stripe reported $1.9 trillion in total payment volume in 2025, up 34% year over year, as reported by CNBC; the figure comes from the company.

evidence.quote: The company also provided an update on its business, with total payment volume increasing to $1.9 trillion in 2025, up 34% over the year prior
$1.9T in payments volume processed in 2025
Businesses on Stripe processed $1.9 trillion in total payment volume worldwide in 2025, up 34% from 2024, according to Stripe

facts.text: Total payment volume was $1.4 trillion in 2024, up 38% from the prior year.

evidence.quote: Businesses on Stripe generated $1.4 trillion in total payment volume in 2024, up 38% from the prior year
Payment volume: $1.9T processed in 2025, up 34% from $1.4T in 2024

facts.text: A February 2026 tender offer valued Stripe at $159 billion, up from $91.5 billion a year earlier, with Thrive Capital, Coatue and a16z among the buyers and Stripe also repurchasing shares.

evidence.quote: Thrive Capital, Coatue Management, a16z, and others are participating in the tender offer and Stripe will also repurchase shares, the company said in a release
The February 24, 2026 release set a $159 billion valuation, named Thrive Capital, Coatue and a16z among the buyers, and said Stripe would also use a portion of its own capital to repurchase shares

facts.text: PM Insights puts Stripe's secondary-market valuation at $185.96 billion, about 17% above the latest tender offer.

evidence.quote: Stripe’s Secondary-Market Valuation Reaches $185.96B, 16.96% Above Its Latest Tender Offer Valuation

facts.text: PM Insights estimates 2025 revenue at $6.8 billion, up 33% from $5.1 billion in 2024, and 2025 EBITDA at about $1.2 billion.

evidence.quote: Revenue: Estimated $6.8B in 2025, up 33% from $5.1B in 2024

facts.text: Stripe says it was profitable in 2024 and robustly profitable in 2025, and its president describes it as self-funding; this is self-reported.

evidence.quote: Stripe was profitable in 2024, and we expect to be so in 2025 and beyond
Stripe said it was "robustly" profitable in 2025 while it continued to pursue acquisitions and invest heavily in product development

facts.text: Stripe says its Revenue and Finance Automation suite is on track for a $1 billion annual run rate in 2026; this is self-reported.

evidence.quote: Stripe said its revenue suite is on track to hit an annual run rate of $1 billion in 2026
is on track to hit $1 billion in annual run rate

facts.text: Stripe acquired stablecoin platform Bridge for $1.1 billion, its largest completed acquisition, and also bought Privy and Metronome.

evidence.quote: Last year, it purchased crypto wallet provider Privy, as well as crypto startup Bridge for $1.1 billion, its largest acquisition to date

facts.text: Bloomberg reported that Stripe agreed to acquire AI gateway OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, and Stripe's website says OpenRouter is now part of Stripe.

evidence.quote: Now, Bloomberg said those discussions have led to a deal price of more than $7 billion

facts.text: An independent analysis estimates Stripe's 2025 volume of about $1.9 trillion surpassed Adyen's of about $1.6 trillion for the first time.

evidence.quote: 2025 was the first year Stripe surpassed Adyen’s volume at ~$1.9T vs. Adyen at ~$1.6T

facts.text: Named competitors include Adyen, Braintree, PayPal and Airwallex, which says it serves over 675,000 businesses.

evidence.quote: Trusted by over 675,000 businesses, directly or through our platform customers

facts.text: Stripe is led by co-founders Patrick Collison as CEO and John Collison as President.

evidence.quote: led by co-founder brothers Patrick and John Collison
Stripe co-founder and president John Collison

risks.text: A 35GB dataset allegedly linked to Stripe customers surfaced on a cybercrime forum, with Hudson Rock reporting 669 vendors and 1,033 compromised API keys.

evidence.quote: A 35GB dataset allegedly linked to Stripe customers surfaced on a cybercrime forum, exposing business, customer, and transaction data

risks.text: Large AI customers are diversifying: OpenAI added Adyen alongside Stripe, and Anthropic is weighing building more payments, billing, fraud and tax infrastructure in-house.

evidence.quote: They solved their issues by moving stored card data to an independent intermediary and adding Adyen alongside Stripe, so they can route volume across processors
Anthropic is weighing whether to build more of its billing, payments, fraud and tax infrastructure in-house as its revenue surges

risks.text: Large customers such as Shopify, Lyft and DoorDash have historically pushed rates down and added second processors, and a rising share of revenue from AI companies ties Stripe more closely to one sector.

evidence.quote: SaaStr noted that as early customers like Shopify, Lyft and DoorDash grew, they pushed rates down and added second processors

risks.text: Stripe's chief technology officer left for Anthropic in 2025 with no announced successor, and a July bid for PayPal was abandoned in August.

evidence.quote: the chief technology officer left for Anthropic in 2025 (Anthropic) with no successor appointment in the newsroom, and a July bid for PayPal was abandoned in August (Bloomberg)

risks.text: Stripe does not publish revenue or net income, so revenue and EBITDA figures are outside estimates.

evidence.quote: As a privately held company, Stripe does not release information about its revenue and net income
Profitability: Estimated $1.2B EBITDA in 2025, Stripe reported profitability in 2024

risks.text: Merchants complain of funds being held for months after account shutdowns.

evidence.quote: We are UK based and had in excess of £250,000 held for over 6 months

risks.text: Stripe's tracking technology is cited in a California privacy class action filed against merchant Crumbl.

evidence.quote: The 18-page lawsuit alleges Crumbl has violated a California privacy law by embedding into CrumblCookies.com web-tracking technology provided by Stripe that secretly intercepts and monitors consumers’ online activity

risks.text: Stripe cut 300 jobs in January 2025 after earlier cuts in 2022 and 2023.

evidence.quote: The company cut 40 positions in July 2023, and slashed its workforce by 14% in late 2022
Two reductions are on the record, in November 2022 and in January 2025

open_questions: What are Stripe's audited revenue, net income and take rate, and how do they compare with outside estimates of $6.8 billion revenue?
What was the scope of the alleged customer data exposure, and were Stripe's own systems compromised or only customer API keys?
How much revenue comes from the largest AI customers, and how much volume has shifted to Adyen or in-house stacks?
What were the final price and terms of the OpenRouter acquisition, and how will it be integrated?
Who has replaced the departed CTO, and why was the PayPal bid abandoned?
What is the timeline for liquidity, given leadership says an IPO is not a priority?
